# Base image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable and widely supported environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Prevent interactive prompts during package installation
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, compilers, MPI, and utilities
# ca-certificates is included for secure network operations (e.g., git, wget)
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments by excluding loopback and docker bridge interfaces
# This is a common practice to ensure MPI traffic is routed correctly in container orchestrators.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a consistent build directory
WORKDIR /build

# Build and install METIS 4.0.3 from source
# This version's Makefile lacks an 'install' target, so we manually copy the library and header.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    cp libmetis.a /usr/local/lib/ && \
    cp Lib/metis.h /usr/local/include/ && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf metis-4.0.3 metis-4.0.3.tar.gz

# Build and install HYPRE 2.28.0 from source
# Explicitly set the install prefix to /usr/local to ensure MFEM can find HYPRE headers.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    CC=mpicc CXX=mpicxx ./configure --prefix=/usr/local --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cd ../.. && \
    rm -rf hypre-2.28.0 v2.28.0.tar.gz

# Build MFEM 4.7 and then Laghos in a single layer.
# FIX: Link Laghos directly against the MFEM build directory (../mfem) instead of a system install.
# This is a more robust build pattern that avoids potential library path issues.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    cd .. && \
    git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=../mfem && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    gfortran \
    git \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    openmpi-bin && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments by excluding loopback and docker bridge interfaces
# This is a common practice to ensure MPI traffic is routed correctly in container orchestrators.
RUN echo "btl_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf && \
    echo "oob_tcp_if_exclude = lo,docker0" >> /etc/openmpi/openmpi-mca-params.conf

# Set a consistent build directory
WORKDIR /build

# Build and install METIS 4.0.3 from source
# The specified OPTFLAGS are required to handle implicit function declaration warnings as errors.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf metis-4.0.3.tar.gz && \
    cd metis-4.0.3 && \
    make OPTFLAGS="-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration" && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf metis-4.0.3 metis-4.0.3.tar.gz

# Build and install HYPRE 2.28.0 from source
# Fortran is disabled and bigint is enabled as per requirements for compatibility with the stack.
RUN wget --no-check-certificate https://github.com/hypre-space/hypre/archive/refs/tags/v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    tar -xzvf v2.28.0.tar.gz && \
    cd hypre-2.28.0/src && \
    ./configure --disable-fortran --enable-bigint && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    make install && \
    cd ../.. && \
    rm -rf hypre-2.28.0 v2.28.0.tar.gz

# Build and install MFEM 4.7 from source
# The build is configured for parallel execution with MPI and linked against the previously built HYPRE and METIS.
RUN git clone https://github.com/mfem/mfem.git && \
    cd mfem && \
    git checkout v4.7 && \
    make parallel -j$(nproc) MFEM_USE_MPI=YES HYPRE_DIR=/usr/local METIS_DIR=/usr/local && \
    make install && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Build the Laghos application from source
# The build links against the previously installed MFEM library.
RUN git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=/usr/local

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

    git clone https://github.com/CEED/Laghos.git && \
    cd Laghos && \
    make -j$(nproc) MFEM_DIR=../mfem && \
    cd .. && \
    rm -rf mfem

# Copy the final executable to a location on the system's PATH
# This makes the application directly runnable without specifying its full path.
RUN cp /build/Laghos/laghos /usr/local/bin/

# Set the final working directory to the Laghos source directory
# This ensures that the required 'data' directory is readily accessible at runtime.
WORKDIR /build/Laghos

# Set a default command to start an interactive shell
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

context.details:
Build laghos, building hyre, metis, and mfem from source first. 
You MUST install hypre 2.28.0 and disable fortran and add the --enable-bigint flag.
You MUST install metis 4.0.3 from https://github.com/mfem/tpls/raw/gh-pages/metis-4.0.3.tar.gz and add OPTFLAGS=-Wno-error=implicit-function-declaration.
You MUST install mfem 4.7 and make parallel.
You MUST ensure all globbed files from ./data from the root of the laghos codebase are in the WORKDIR.
